Ministry of Education, Science, Vocational Training and Early Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Agricultural Science Syllabus, Grades 10-12' (2013, published by CDC, ISBN 9982-00-548-X) — Grade 10, Topics 10.1-10.9. This is a genuine gap fill: this app previously had no OBC Grade 10-12 Agricultural Science content at all, only the separate CBC Form 1 entry. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the syllabus's own Content (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled OBC subject in this app (Geography, Biology, etc.).

The syllabus organizes content by Grade and numbered Topic only, not by Term. STRUCTURAL TERM SPLIT (not sourced, same convention as this app's Biology Grade 10-12 files): the 9 real topics below are divided into three equal groups of 3 topics each, in their original curriculum order (10.1-10.3, 10.4-10.6, 10.7-10.9), labelled 'Term 1'/'Term 2'/'Term 3' purely so the app can generate and share one term at a time. This division is an organizational split only — no topic, sub-topic, or competency was added, removed, or altered.

Real irregularities in the source table (an OCR/column extraction of a scanned syllabus) are documented, not silently corrected: (1) the printed sub-topic header '10.5.2 Organic and Conventional methods of farming' carries two distinct runs of numbered outcomes in the raw table, '10.5.2.1-10.5.2.2' and '10.5.3.1-10.5.3.2' — the syllabus's own Appendix I 'Scope and Sequence Chart' lists this as a single sub-topic, so all four outcomes are kept together here under that one sub-topic, matching the Appendix; (2) elsewhere numbering is internally consistent and reproduced as printed. No individual person's name is cited here — the syllabus's own front-matter signatories (a Permanent Secretary and a Director, both signing in their official government capacity) are omitted as unnecessary to a curriculum citation, consistent with how this app cites every other CDC syllabus.
